summary: Firelookout.ca lists a Fording lookout in East Kootenay, BC, at 50.19919, -114.93828; no other source describing it was found.

evidence.supports: Location given as East Kootenay, BC, Canada

notes_for_editor: Only the Firelookout.ca register entry, which gives a name, region and coordinates. Its elevation, tower type, height and year built fields are blank, and it has no status line. Two web searches found nothing about a Fording lookout; results were unrelated (the Rocky Mountain Trench encyclopedia entry, a Teck mine access map, other provinces). The story is a short location stub with no history, so the brief's kind and status remain unknown. An editor should consider holding publication until a source for the tower itself is found. The brief's local unit, Regional District of East Kootenay, is left out of the story because the cited page does not name it.
